Bash(gh pr create --title "Add performance range: best and worst single-game stats" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

- Adds a **Performance Range** section to each player card, showing their best and worst individual game of the season side by side
- Skaters: ranked by points \(tiebreak: goals, then TOI\); displays G/A/P/+\\-/SOG/TOI per game
- Goalies: ranked by SV% among started games with ≥10 shots faced; displays SV%/SV/SA/GA/Result
- Each game shows opponent context \(date · vs/@ TEAM\) in green \(best\) and red \(worst\) labels
- Section auto-hides for players with no qualifying data \(no games, goalie relief-only\)

## Test plan

- [ ] Start the web server and search for a high-volume skater — confirm Performance Range appears between Season Stats and Splits with a plausible best/worst game
- [ ] Search for a goalie — verify best/worst shows SV% games with W/L/OTL result
- [ ] Search for a player with very few games — section should still render correctly
- [ ] Confirm section is hidden for a relief-only goalie \(if one exists in the DB\)
- [ ] No console errors in browser

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
\)")
